sources.title: tt-metal/models/demos/blackhole/qwen36 at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: The 27B variants (both Qwen3.5-27B and Qwen3.6-27B) run on a P150x4 (a (1, 4) Blackhole mesh) using 4-way tensor parallelism (TP). The TP path needs FABRIC_1D for the cross-device collectives (all-reduce / reduce-scatter) and a trace region for the captured chunk-outer prefill trace.
